metadata.title: The Existential Dread of Unpopped Popcorn
metadata.description: We've all been there. You're settling in for a cozy night, ready to be consumed by the cinematic brilliance of your chosen streaming service. Then it happens. That one rogue kernel, mocking you from its un-popped purgatory. It's a tiny, infuriating testament to the universe's cruel sense of humor.  This stickman is battling the ultimate snack-time nemesis, a fight we understand on a spiritual level.
